value: LinkedIn algorithm favours: early engagement (first 60-90 min critical), text-only or native documents over links, questions that generate comments, consistent 3-5x/week posting, replies to every comment.
Twitter/X growth: reply first (build network before posting), threads outperform single tweets 3:1, post at 8-10am or 5-7pm local time, use 1-2 hashtags max, hook must be first 140 chars.

Viral content triggers: awe, anger, anxiety, or amusement (emotion > information). Novelty + relatability. Practical utility. Stories over statistics. Specific details beat vague claims. Contrarian takes on accepted wisdom.

Subject: personalised or curiosity-driven (< 50 chars). Opening: specific compliment or shared context (not generic). Value: one sentence. CTA: micro-commitment, not a big ask. P.S.: reinforce value. Total < 150 words.

BATNA (Best Alternative to Negotiated Agreement) determines your walk-away point. Anchor high. Never split the difference on price — change terms instead. Silence is powerful after stating your position. Seek win-win, not win-lose.

Lose clients who choose on price alone — they become problem clients. Differentiate on: specific insight about their problem, clear methodology, results-based positioning, references from similar projects.
Value-based pricing: price based on outcome to client, not hours. Test your rate by raising 20% on next proposal. If 0% rejection = too low. 50% rejection = too high. Target 10-20% rejection rate.

On-page: target keyword in title, H1, first 100 words, URL slug, alt text. Off-page: acquire backlinks from relevant DR>40 domains. Technical: Core Web Vitals, mobile-first, site speed < 3s, structured data.

Subject line determines 50% of open rate. Personalisation lifts opens 26%. Best send times: Tuesday/Thursday 10am. Segmentation increases revenue 760% vs blast emails. Abandoned cart email = #1 highest ROI automation.
